description: Are our sensor reads succeeding, and what do they read? Read counts by outcome and the last temperature, per pod. Opens on sensor-team-2; widen the filters to compare.

panels.description: Requests per second across the selection. Drops to zero: the app stopped serving. Empty: the app doesn't emit http_request_duration_seconds yet; see doc/app-teams/1-metrics.md.

targets.expr: sum((rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", job="open-cluster-management-addon-observability/app-metrics"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (workload, node) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod", created_by_name=~"(?:$workload)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?", created_by_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "workload", "$1", "created_by_name", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]+") or label_replace(kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod", created_by_name=~"(?:$workload)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?", created_by_kind!="ReplicaSet"}, "workload", "$1", "created_by_name", "(.*)")))
